result.rationale: The diff shows GoogleCalendarService now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` then `const token = res?.data`. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set, refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw `fetch` Response (per its own definition in the diff), which has no `.data` property, so `token` is undefined and `token.access_token` throws TypeError inside the existing try/catch — a real behavioral defect introduced by this diff.
